title: GaggiMate KB Base Document
description: Base frontmatter schema applied to every .md file under knowledge-base/. Bucket-specific schemas extend this via allOf composition.

id.description: Stable identifier; conventionally <bucket>/<subarea>/<slug> matching the file path.

created.description: ISO-8601 date the file was first created.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date of most recent material change.

last_reviewed.description: ISO-8601 date this file was last verified for correctness.

owner.description: Person or agent name responsible for maintenance. Optional; default unset.

tags.description: Lowercase-kebab tags. Use sparingly; not a substitute for bucket placement.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'superseded' files must set superseded_by. 'speculative' is for far-future or pre-citation content where normal review standards do not apply.

superseded_by.description: Required when status=superseded; path to the replacement file.

doc_type.description: Diátaxis quadrant. Files mixing quadrants must be split.

confidence.description: Author's confidence in the correctness of the file.

schema_version.description: Frontmatter schema version. Bump when fields change incompatibly.

sources.description: Cited source identifiers (BibTeX keys or DOIs). Optional helper field.
